name: singlet_dim_reduction_deep_generative_latent_embedding
title: Deep generative latent embedding of cells
description: Fits a nonlinear count latent model to raw UMI counts and writes an n-by-d cell embedding (posterior mean, with variance for variational models). The default method is scvi, a scVI-type VAE with a negative-binomial head; linear_scvi, scanvi and dca are alternatives. Use it to compare count-likelihood embeddings with covariates at matched dimension; use dim-reduction.normalized_cell_embedding (PCA) for the default embedding. Stochastic and long-running; dry_run returns time and memory estimates without fitting.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Model: scvi (default), linear_scvi (linear decoder), scanvi (needs labels_key), or dca (count autoencoder).

n_latent.description: Latent dimension d, the bottleneck width for dca. Use the same d for every method compared.

batch_key.description: obs column of study or batch covariates for scvi, linear_scvi and scanvi; null for none.

labels_key.description: obs column of partial labels with a reserved unlabelled value; required for scanvi, null otherwise.

use_hvg.description: Fit only var/highly_variable genes; false fits all genes and is slower.

scvi.description: Options for scvi, linear_scvi and scanvi; rejected when method is dca.

n_hidden.description: Hidden width of encoder and decoder networks.

n_layers.description: Hidden layers in encoder and decoder; 2 matches the OpenProblems configuration.

dropout_rate.description: Dropout inside encoder and decoder networks.

gene_likelihood.description: Count likelihood: nb, or zinb to add a per cell-gene dropout probability.

max_epochs.description: Training epochs; null uses the library epoch rule, which shortens as cell count grows.

dca.description: Options for dca; rejected when method is not dca.

ae_type.description: Output likelihood head of the count autoencoder.

hidden_size.description: Encoder and decoder widths around the bottleneck of width n_latent. The upstream default (64, 32, 64) corresponds to [64] here, with its 32-unit bottleneck replaced by n_latent.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for initialisation, minibatch order and the KL schedule.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/X_deep_latent. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, embedding_key, n_latent, gene_likelihood, epochs_trained, final_train_loss, device_used. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
